messages.subject: Benchmarks for irace testing
parts:
Hello everyone,

We are in the search of benchmarks to test new improvements on irace!

I wanted to ask if some of you have algorithms that could be used for testing, 
all types of algorithms are welcome and the only requirements are that they should execute 
without major problems and their setup should not be very complex.

For now, we would need:
1. Source code (if compilation is required)
2. Set of instances (test and training)
3. Parameter space definition

If you are interested, we can keep you informed about the best parameter settings we find and
their performance. 

If you want to collaborate with your algorithm, please contact me: 
leslie...@gmail.com

Thanks!

Leslie.
